queries.local_description: Control query for all 42 BHSA occurrences of טף. Its reference and word-slot set is compared with the Context Fabric result.
Control query for verses in which טף occurs with at least one of אישׁ, אשׁה, or גר.
Control query for a verse containing טף together with אישׁ, אשׁה, and גר.
Negative control for the Deuteronomy 31:12 audience combination אישׁ, אשׁה, and גר in a verse without טף.
Control query for verses in which טף occurs with גר in a verse.
